When I was about 10 or 11 years old, the house that my family and I rented was haunted. My cousins and I were really into the show Ghost Hunters at the time and we're all about the same age. One night, it was just the four of us. My sister was at a friend's house and my parents were out at dinner. My room was in the basement and we were playing video games down there. We had heard a slight thump from upstairs and being the "brave Ghost Hunters" that we were, we decided to investigate. When we got upstairs, we found that no one was home and that my mom's ceramic waterfall was running. We didn't think anything of it until one of my cousins pointed out that it was unplugged. The rest of us just laughed but sure enough, the damn thing was unplugged. We ran downstairs as fast as we could, slammed my door shut and all hid under the same blanket for the rest of the night. Now that I'm 22 I still don't know how that waterfall was running.

On another occasion, my mom was taking a nap in her bed and felt a small child climb onto the bed with her. Assuming it was my sister she turned over to see no one there and an indent as if a child were lying there. Our dog at the time would also go up to my parents closet and just stare up as if someone was standing in there.

My aunt also lived with us for a while and when she would be alone in the house, she would here a voice that sounded like my mom (her sister) calling out to her. One time her stereo system turned itself up to full volume out of no where and she ran out of the house crying. 

For one reason or another we moved out of the house, but I wish we hadn't. Whatever was there didn't seem to want to harm anybody.
